raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
- Let the `umbp_llm` fixture take pool options through indirect parametrization.
- Add `test_restore_under_pool_eviction` on a 64 MiB pool: the newest prompt restores exactly, the oldest is evicted.

The existing end-to-end UMBP tests never fill the pool, so the connector and scheduler path under eviction never runs, and `test_mori_embedded_gpu.py` only overfills it at the runtime level. Prompts run one at a time so MORI's LRU commit order is deterministic, and the pool size assumes Qwen3-0.6B KV on MORI's 64 KiB pages. On MI350X with MORI v1.2.3.post1 built with UMBP, `pytest -v -s -rs v1/kv_connector/umbp_integration/test_mori_token_e2e.py` gave 3 passed and the new test passed 10/10 in a loop. With a 1 GiB pool the same flow restores the oldest prompt in full, so the miss comes from eviction. While probing this we found that equal watermarks, or a high watermark at or below MORI's default low of 0.7, silently disable eviction; that fix is a separate PR. No open UMBP PR covers end-to-end restore under eviction.

AI assistance (Claude Code) was used to draft this change. Every line was reviewed by the submitter.

raw_graphql_pull_request.title: [Test][UMBP] Cover end-to-end restore while the embedded DRAM pool is evicting

detail.body:
- Let the `umbp_llm` fixture take pool options through indirect parametrization.
- Add `test_restore_under_pool_eviction` on a 64 MiB pool: the newest prompt restores exactly, the oldest is evicted.

The existing end-to-end UMBP tests never fill the pool, so the connector and scheduler path under eviction never runs, and `test_mori_embedded_gpu.py` only overfills it at the runtime level. Prompts run one at a time so MORI's LRU commit order is deterministic, and the pool size assumes Qwen3-0.6B KV on MORI's 64 KiB pages. On MI350X with MORI v1.2.3.post1 built with UMBP, `pytest -v -s -rs v1/kv_connector/umbp_integration/test_mori_token_e2e.py` gave 3 passed and the new test passed 10/10 in a loop. With a 1 GiB pool the same flow restores the oldest prompt in full, so the miss comes from eviction. While probing this we found that equal watermarks, or a high watermark at or below MORI's default low of 0.7, silently disable eviction; that fix is a separate PR. No open UMBP PR covers end-to-end restore under eviction.

AI assistance (Claude Code) was used to draft this change. Every line was reviewed by the submitter.
detail.title: [Test][UMBP] Cover end-to-end restore while the embedded DRAM pool is evicting

files.patch:
@@ -29,13 +29,15 @@
 
 @pytest.fixture
 def umbp_llm(vllm_runner, socket_dir, monkeypatch, request):
+    options = dict(getattr(request, "param", {}))
+    tp_size = options.pop("tensor_parallel_size", 1)
     monkeypatch.setattr(envs, "VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT", True)
     monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT", "1")
     with vllm_runner(
         QWEN_MODEL,
         revision=_REVISIONS[QWEN_MODEL],
         enforce_eager=True,
-        tensor_parallel_size=getattr(request, "param", 1),
+        tensor_parallel_size=tp_size,
         block_size=BLOCK_SIZE,
         enable_prefix_caching=True,
         disable_log_stats=False,
@@ -46,6 +48,7 @@ def umbp_llm(vllm_runner, socket_dir, monkeypatch, request):
                 "mode": "embedded",
                 "capacity_bytes": 1 << 30,
                 "lookup_dir": socket_dir,
+                **options,
             },
         ),
     ) as runner:
@@ -97,8 +100,12 @@ def _assert_same_outputs(expected, actual) -> None:
 @pytest.mark.parametrize(
     "umbp_llm",
     [
-        pytest.param(1, id="tp1"),
-        pytest.param(2, id="tp2", marks=multi_gpu_marks(num_gpus=2)),
+        pytest.param({"tensor_parallel_size": 1}, id="tp1"),
+        pytest.param(
+            {"tensor_parallel_size": 2},
+            id="tp2",
+            marks=multi_gpu_marks(num_gpus=2),
+        ),
     ],
     indirect=True,
 )
@@ -136,3 +143,33 @@ def test_restore_extends_a_local_prefix_hit(umbp_llm):
     assert mixed[0].num_cached_tokens == 8 * BLOCK_SIZE
     assert _external_tokens(umbp_llm) - before == 6 * BLOCK_SIZE
     _assert_same_outputs(computed, mixed)
+
+
+# Eight full blocks of Qwen3-0.6B KV take 14 MiB, so this pool starts evicting
+# after about three prompts.
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "umbp_llm",
+    [
+        {
+            "capacity_bytes": 64 << 20,
+            "dram_high_watermark": 0.75,
+            "dram_low_watermark": 0.5,
+        }
+    ],
+    ids=["64MiB"],
+    indirect=True,
+)
+def test_restore_under_pool_eviction(umbp_llm):
+    """The newest prompt survives eviction exactly and the oldest is gone."""
+    prompts = [_prompt(seed, 8 * BLOCK_SIZE + 7) for seed in range(8)]
+    computed = [umbp_llm.generate(p, PARAMS, use_tqdm=False)[0] for p in prompts]
+    _reset_gpu_prefix_cache(umbp_llm)
+
+    before = _external_tokens(umbp_llm)
+    newest = umbp_llm.generate(prompts[-1], PARAMS, use_tqdm=False)
+    assert _external_tokens(umbp_llm) - before == 8 * BLOCK_SIZE
+    _assert_same_outputs([computed[-1]], newest)
+
+    before = _external_tokens(umbp_llm)
+    umbp_llm.generate(prompts[0], PARAMS, use_tqdm=False)
+    assert _external_tokens(umbp_llm) == before
